description: What edited_layers.toml resolves to on each OS, written by hand as the oracle of the layer editor's end-to-end path. edited_layers.toml is the file the scripted editing session of tools/test/test-layer-editor-model.cjs writes through _shared/ui/layer_editor/layer_model.js (the recommended layer, then KeyT edited once on each OS and KeyG given its normal behaviour back on Windows); each driver's host test saves it through its bridge and checks its generated layer. Values are the loaders' canonical resolution text; null means the key keeps its normal behaviour.
